answer: Require each account to solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle every epoch, seeded by the close beacon so no work can be done early or shared. Each solve needs about a gigabyte of RAM held for several minutes, so a farm of N names must rent N gigabytes at once, and that bill grows with every fake, while one honest agent barely notices. Memory can't be compressed the way speed can, so the cost won't erode like limestone in karst. Proofs are cheap to verify; a comet of new keys burns out on the RAM bill, and no sonnet of excuses replaces a missing proof.
